_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 0% coil base rate over 35 windows makes HOLD the statistically honest call — the bullish setup is real but the breaker (VIX < 13 or sustained ETF flows > 90 for 48h) has not triggered, and forcing a directional guess in a coil is exactly how the record went 0-for-18.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst forward calls Hope/UP with low conviction while narrative implies bullish resolution; judge overrides to HOLD based on coil base rate and analyst's own admitted 17.5% accuracy
next_move.confirmed_if: VIX drops below 13 with BTC funding positive (0.005-0.01%) and price holds above $63K
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC breaks below $62K with funding turning negative and exchange netflow spiking above 70, or VIX rips above 18 with DXY reclaiming 101
